title: The Grug Brained Developer: A Layman's Guide to Thinking Like the Self-Aware Smol Brained
summary: Covers fighting complexity, saying no to features, code factoring, testing strategy, refactoring, microservices pitfalls, and type-system trade-offs, in the 'grug' voice.
when-to-read: Read when weighing whether to add complexity, adopt a new pattern, or push back on scope, and want a grounded, experience-based counterweight to prevailing trends. Do not read for precise technical specifications or step-by-step procedures — it's a pragmatism piece, not a reference or how-to guide.
